INSTRUCTIONS

- You act by calling the tool “action” exactly once. Everything in the tool is optional except the notes.
- Messages you send reach the recipient in the next round.
- A card request means that one person asks another to send 1–2 cards, while offering the same number of their own cards. The person asking chooses which cards to offer. The recipient sees the offered cards and can accept (choosing which cards to send back) or decline. Cards offered in an open request are reserved until the request is answered or withdrawn.
- If you have nothing to do until someone contacts you, you can set “wait” to true. You will then not be called again until something new happens.
- The exercise lasts at most 60 rounds.
- You only see your own cards and what has been sent to you.
